title: Rosalind and the Cover
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Freya Voss, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
